detail: The disclosure was filed with NSE under the SEBI Takeover Regulations requiring substantial acquirers to inform the exchange and public. Regulation 31(4) mandates disclosure once a threshold of 25% voting shares is crossed, triggering potential open-offer liability. The specific acquirer identity, shareholding percentage, consideration, and deal structure are contained in the full disclosure document but not publicly summarized in the headline notice.
